name: canvas-mcp
description: Canvas MCP server for courses, assignments, planning, content, collaboration, and confirmed local-file submissions.
long_description: Canvas MCP is a local-first Model Context Protocol server for Canvas. It connects to a user-provided Canvas domain and OAuth token store created by the browser login helper, then exposes mostly read-only student-focused tools for courses, assignments, planner items, announcements, modules, files, discussions, quizzes, groups, conversations, and schedules. It also includes an explicitly confirmed local-file assignment submission tool for assignments that accept online_upload submissions.

canvas_domain.title: Canvas domain
canvas_domain.description: Canvas host name, for example canvas.northwestern.edu.

canvas_oauth_token_path.title: OAuth token store path (optional)
canvas_oauth_token_path.description: Optional path to a token store created by npm run auth:login. Defaults to ~/.canvas-mcp/tokens/<domain>.json.
